messages:
nina_support: Team, customer report: EUR wire to 'Altura GmbH' was returned by the receiving bank. Bank note: \"INVALID_IBAN\" and additional text \"BIC does not match beneficiary account country\". Transfer ref: tx_eur_7f4c. Amount: €18,320. Can payments triage?

martin_payments: On it. Can you paste the payment payload (mask acct) and full bank return message? Also whether they supplied an IBAN with spaces or lowercase.

nina_support: Payload (masked):
```
{
  "amount": 18320,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "iban": "de44 1000 0000 0123 4567 89",
  "bic": "ALTRDEFFXXX",
  "beneficiary_name": "Altura GmbH"
}
```
Bank return: \"Payment returned - invalid IBAN (format/length) - BIC country mismatch (DE vs FR)\". Partner bank code PB-3002.

payments-bot: Ticket created: PAY-9034 (assigned to payments). Notifying customer. :bell:

martin_payments: Quick trace: our API accepted the IBAN as-is and we forwarded to correspondent. Partner-bank-bot shows we sent IBAN with spaces preserved and lower/upper mixed case. Their validator rejects non-canonical IBANs. Also BIC appears to be for a different bank (ALTRDEFFXXX is the beneficiary's bank but partner expects ALTRDEFFYYY for the local clearing branch).

sam_sre: We currently validate IBAN with a permissive regex but do not canonicalize (remove spaces, uppercase). Small fix: canonicalize IBAN -> remove spaces, toUpperCase() before checksum/format validation. Also add BIC-country consistency check (country code in IBAN must match BIC country). I'll open a PR with tests.

martin_payments: For remediation: options are reissue with canonicalized IBAN + correct BIC, or refund then re-create. Customer wants reissue and proof for their AP. Felix, any accounting constraints?

felix_finance: Cancel+create is our preferred path to keep the ledger clean. We'll mark original tx_eur_7f4c as \"returned\" and create a new tx_eur_7f4c-reissue. Please include original invoice reference on new payout. If customer asks for credit memo we can issue it after.

nina_support: I asked the customer for corrected BIC and confirmed IBAN without spaces: they replied with IBAN \"DE441000000000123456789\" and BIC \"ALTRDEFFYYY\". They said their bank required the branch BIC.

martin_payments: Running a partner dry-run:
```
curl -X POST https://partner.bank/validate_wire \
  -d '{"iban":"DE441000000000123456789","bic":"ALTRDEFFYYY","amount":18320}'

Response: 200 OK {"status":"accepted","trace":"PB-3002-DRY"}
```

martin_payments: Good to go. I'll cancel original and create reissue under tx_eur_7f4c-reissue. ETA ~25m. Will attach partner acceptance trace to ticket.

sam_sre: PR note: add automated IBAN normalization step in payments service, and a QA case for mixed-case and spacey IBANs. Canary to 5% first. Also adding a BIC-vs-IBAN-country mismatch warning to the UI (soft block) to surface to customers before submit.

felix_finance: Accounting logged the cancel+create plan. We'll reconcile once new tx settles. If customer needs a memo for AP, support can attach one.

partner-bank-bot: Payment tx_eur_7f4c status updated -> returned. Reason: INVALID_IBAN / BIC_MISMATCH. PB ref: PB-3002.

payments-bot: New payment created: tx_eur_7f4c-reissue (linked). Ticket PAY-9034 updated.

nina_support: Customer confirmed they received the reissue confirmation and that their bank accepted the new instruction. I sent them the partner trace and the new payment ref for reconciliation.

martin_payments: Closing loop: updated ledger with return + reissue entries, attached partner trace and new tx id.

sam_sre: I'll merge the IBAN normalization PR after canary metrics look good. Added an alert to catch similar returns at partner level for quick follow-up.

felix_finance: All good from finance side. Marking accounting tasks resolved once settlement posts.

nina_support: Closing ticket PAY-9034 after settlement confirmation. Thanks team :tada:
